notes.title: Warden of the Isles 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.1.1 is live!

Changes:
 Moved Oculus hand position
 Spells in menu no longer highlighted when out of influence area
 Showing warning message when game window loses focus

notes.title: Warden of the Isles 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 is live!

New Features
 Snap turn support using touchpads or joysticks.
Audio volume control
Height adjustment controls


Balancing:
 Tutorial levels are now shorter
 Units detect range is reduced
